functions.action: Open checkout with the dish ×2 in the cart
functions.expected: Every fair-bill line, the total and the Pay button equal the pricing API's quote

functions.action: Choose Pickup at checkout, then Delivery
functions.expected: Pickup: a pickup quote with no delivery fee or tip line, the bill equals it; Delivery: back to the delivery quote
functions.verify: UI: bill; API: the quotes the page received (fulfillment)

functions.action: With the city's BhojanGo offer budget set and the code's offer resumed: a wrong promo code, then the city's code (BOISE5 / FEAST100), then Remove
functions.expected: The wrong code says it doesn't apply and changes nothing; the right one says applied and adds the discount the quote has; Remove takes it off
functions.verify: UI: promo-state (applied or not), bill lines and total; API: the quotes the page received (promotion line with detail.promo_code)

functions.action: Choose each tip chip, then Other with a typed amount
functions.expected: The tip line and total follow each chip; the chips are the city's tip presets
functions.verify: UI: tip chips, bill; API: the quote for each tip

functions.action: Pay, then Decline in the test provider's checkout
functions.expected: 'Your payment didn't go through' and no charge: the order stays unpaid, the price held
functions.verify: UI: the alert; API: the order's payment status is not paid

functions.action: Pay with the market's method (US card, India UPI) and Approve in the test provider's checkout
functions.expected: Tracking opens; the stored order's lines and total equal the quote paid; payment captured once
functions.verify: UI: Pay, tracking URL; API: GET /orders/{id}, /pricing/orders/{id}/snapshot; DB: orders.total, payments

functions.action: Open checkout with an empty cart
functions.expected: 'Your cart is empty' and Find something to eat
Sign in first, then back to checkout

functions.action: Open the page with core-api stopped
functions.expected: It still renders (no crash page, no blank) and says it couldn't load; in under 4 s (R43)
functions.verify: UI: body text, no Next.js error page; the page's navigation timing (DOMContentLoaded < 4 s)

functions.action: At checkout (price held), the restaurant raises the dish's price; then Pay
functions.expected: The order is charged the held (quoted) price, not the new one
functions.verify: UI: Pay amount; API: the quote the page received, GET /orders/{id}; DB: orders.total, the order's item price

functions.action: At checkout, the restaurant raises the price; the 10-minute hold runs out (browser clock moved on); Get a fresh price
functions.expected: The cart is re-priced and says 'Price changed: <dish> <old> → <new>' above Pay; Pay = the new quote's total
functions.verify: UI: the notice, the Pay amount; API: the old and new quotes the page received (items' unit_price)

functions.action: Menu → cart → checkout → Stripe Payment Element, card 4242 → tracking to delivered → receipt → refund one dish
functions.expected: Placed by Stripe's webhook; PaymentIntent and charge = the order's total, captured; every status in order; receipt = Stripe's amount; Stripe's Refund = the stored refund; payment row partially refunded
functions.verify: Stripe API (PaymentIntent, Charge, Refund) vs API (order, refunds) and DB (payment_intents)
